title: Menu
description: x-menu builds a vertical menu (role="menu") from a comma-separated item list. Items are focusable, the arrow keys move between them, Enter or Space picks one, and a pick fires wb:menu:select.

items.description: Comma-separated items. Each is a label, or label:value to give it a separate value.

wb:menu:select.description: An item was clicked or picked from the keyboard.

_metadata.derivedFrom: navigation.js menu() — every property here is one the behavior reads
